tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the top bar and the dashboard columns.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialog, inputs, top bar. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, the PDF preview pane, dropzone on hover, read-only fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: table row dividers, card outlines, section separators. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and the dropzone. Holds 3:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on bg, surface, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken: labels, table headers, helper text, placeholders, metadata.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the selected segment, the OPEN status, focus ring. Readable as text on surface, bg and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table row, OPEN badge ground, the 'extracted' tag on review fields, dropzone drag-over.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors, FAILED extraction, the destructive button. Text on surface, bg and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the FAILED badge and of error banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Fields the extraction left empty (dashed border and hint), PENDING extraction. Text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the PENDING badge and of the 'not recognised' hint.

tokens.name: person-1
tokens.usage: Default color of the first person: card top bar and the square marker next to the name. Always shown with the name.

tokens.name: person-2
tokens.usage: Default color of the second person. Same use as person-1.

tokens.name: person-3
tokens.usage: Default color of the third person. Same use as person-1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the dialog (CDK overlay backdrop).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign-in screen and empty state headline only.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Dialog title, person name on a card.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Section heads inside the dialog and cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ziehe die PDF-Rechnung hierher oder wähle eine Datei aus.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper and error text, metadata.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, badge text. Set uppercase via CSS, keep the source string in sentence case.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Totals on person cards. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Amounts in tables and the amount input. Always tabular-nums, right aligned.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge dot and its text, icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, label to input, cell padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and table cell padding horizontal.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on narrow screens, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding, gap between dashboard columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between dialog sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Grid module of the brand (cover, empty state). Vertical rhythm between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty state padding.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The only radius. Every element, including inputs, selects, checkboxes, scrollbars, focus rings and the dialog, has square corners.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog and menus only. Cards on the page use a line border, no shadow.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: All borders and dividers.

tokens.name: border-bar
tokens.usage: Person color bar on top of a person card, active step indicator.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls in the top bar on narrow screens and inside tables.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the dashboard content area.

tokens.name: dialog-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the claim dialog in the review step. Entry step uses 560px.
